headline: Signs Your Guest Bathroom Layout Needs Professional Attention
articleBody:
Thinking about refreshing your secondary bath on your own? Some challenges point directly toward hiring a licensed contractor rather than taking on the job solo.

When to Call a Professional:
- Persistent moisture or hidden leaks: Discovering soft subflooring, degraded drywall, or damaged framing under old tile requires structural repairs before new finishes go down.
- Relocating key plumbing fixtures: Shifting a toilet, vanity drain, or shower valve demands careful pipe planning, venting, and trade permits to keep lines flowing properly.
- Electrical additions: Installing new vanity lighting, exhaust fans, or GFCI receptacles often calls for a dedicated bathroom circuit to manage modern power needs safely.
- Ventilation challenges: Exhausting moist air through an attic instead of properly out the exterior wall or roof creates long-term hazards that require mechanical knowledge.
- Major layout reconfiguration: Moving interior partition walls or altering doorways calls for experienced structural review and drafting.

When Professional Guidance Helps:
Tackling rough-in plumbing, mechanical ventilation, and waterproofing requires strict attention to building standards so your finished space stays protected for years. Reach out to Blue Lake Construction at 385-202-5987 to get your guest bathroom project planned and built correctly.
